subject: Re: Kickoff: behavioral dispositions eval for the assistant
body:
Priya,

Staffing and platform:

- Csilla 60% (psychometrics + scoring methodology), Ondrej 50% (model harness), Saoirse 50% (data + Evalline integration).
- Compute is negligible - inference-only evals, a few hundred GPU-hours total on titan-a100.
- Platform: the big scheduling driver is data migration. Heads-up that the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-06-26, so the SJT corpus and all annotation tables must be fully migrated to v2 by then - I'm pulling Saoirse onto migration at 50% for the next month to make that date. It compresses her Evalline work, which is why the harness onboarding milestone slips a week, to 6/12.
- Evalline: Tomas's team confirmed a slot for us; standing eval registration needs the scoring spec from Csilla by 5/29.

Tight but doable.

Bao
